src: const t = box(60, 40, 30); const sk = sketch('top', -2.2); sk.rect(1.7, 6.1, { at: [8.8, 8.9] }); groove(sk, t, 270);

brep.refused: groove groove1 would leave a sealed cavity inside the part instead of opening onto a face -- groove1 is shown without it.

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): the ring lies completely inside the part, so cutting it would leave a sealed hollow with no opening, which cannot be built reliably here; let the ring reach the outside of the part.
